alate: 有翅成虫头壳近似圆形，头盖缝与囟都不清楚，囟前有数条川形纵纹。触角十三至十五节（标本已断）。复眼长径约为它到头下缘间距的三倍。单眼长径约为单复眼间距的三倍，单眼与触角窝的距离约为复眼与触角窝距离的两倍。下颚内颚叶缘毛十一根。
en: Soldiers are yellowish brown on the head, with a slightly paler pronotum and a pale yellow abdomen; no further soldier characters are recorded. Alates have a nearly circular head capsule in which the coronal suture and the fontanelle are indistinct, several short longitudinal striae lying before the fontanelle. Antennae comprise thirteen to fifteen segments, though the specimens are broken. The eye is about three times as long as its distance to the lower margin of the head.
soldier: 兵蚁头部黄褐色，前胸背板色泽稍浅，腹部淡黄色。
